title: Updating the digit-count register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $12$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its digit-count-and-comparison scratch value by $y$.
replaced:
For a register record and a natural number $y$, updating the entry at index $12$ of its
length-fifteen value vector to $y$ gives the value vector of the record obtained by
replacing the scratch value used for the digit count and comparison with $y$.
